shell_commands_self_reported.command: find demo/acme-corp/evidence skill/references -type f 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "---"; ls -la reports 2>/dev/null

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && wc -c $(find . -type f) | tail -40 && echo "--- metadata ---" && grep -inE '^(#|\*\*|- \*\*|status|version|approved|effective|last (reviewed|review)|next review|owner|date|generated|as of|period|classification)' company_profile.md policies/*.md | cut -c1-220

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && ls -l policies reports && grep -inE 'status|version|approv|effective|review|owner|generated|as of|period|classification' company_profile.md policies/*.md | cut -c1-220
for f in company_profile.md policies/*.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in change_management_log.md crowdstrike_endpoint_report.md github_security_report.md vendor_risk_assessment.md jira_change_tickets.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json aws_security_hub.json okta_system_log.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in aws_security_config.json okta_mfa_report.json knowbe4_training_report.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
